local FileInicio = "gotta3_inicio.jpg"
local FileLoop = "gotta3_loop.jpg"

local function carregarImagens()
    -- Aba 1
    local s1, r1 = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(ImgInicioUrl) end)
    if s1 and r1 then writefile(FileInicio, r1) BackgroundInicio.Image = getcustomasset(FileInicio)
    elseif isfile(FileInicio) then BackgroundInicio.Image = getcustomasset(FileInicio) end

    if s2 and r2 then writefile(FileLoop, r2) BackgroundLoop.Image = getcustomasset(FileLoop)

    local s3, r3 = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(ImgEditUrl) end)
    if s3 and r3 then writefile(FileEdit, r3) BackgroundEdit.Image = getcustomasset(FileEdit)
    elseif isfile(FileEdit) then BackgroundEdit.Image = getcustomasset(FileEdit) end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- NÚCLEO LOGICO DOS TELEPORTES E LOOPS
-- =========================================================================
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local saves = {}
local checkpointCFrame = nil 
local loopAtivo = false
local cframeLoopAlvo = nil

-- Loop eterno de background
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if loopAtivo and cframeLoopAlvo and Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cframeLoopAlvo
        end
    end
end)

StopLoopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loopAtivo = false
    cframeLoopAlvo = nil
end)

-- Coleta posição atual para o monitor
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.2) do
        if Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local root = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            checkpointCFrame = root.CFrame
            PosLabel.Text = string.format("Posição: X: %.1f, Y: %.1f, Z: %.1f", root.Position.X, root.Position.Y, root.Position.Z)
        end
    end
end)

-- Sistema de Redesenhar as Listas de TP
local function atualizarLista()
    for _, child in pairs(ScrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end end
    for _, child in pairs(ScrollFrameLoop:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end end

    for name, cframe in pairs(saves) do
        -- Criando na Aba Inicio
        local ItemFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        local TpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        local DelBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

        ItemFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        ItemFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        ItemFrame.Parent = ScrollFrame
        ItemFrame.ZIndex = 3

        TpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 1, 0)
        TpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        TpBtn.Text = "  " .. name
        TpBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        TpBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        TpBtn.Parent = ItemFrame
        TpBtn.ZIndex = 4

        TpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cframe
            end
        end)

        DelBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 1, 0)
        DelBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
        DelBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
        DelBtn.Text = "X"
        DelBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        DelBtn.Parent = ItemFrame
        DelBtn.ZIndex = 4

        DelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            saves[name] = nil
            atualizarLista()
        end)

        -- Criando na Aba Loops
        local ItemFrameLoop = Instance.new("Frame")
        local TpLoopBtnAction = Instance.new("TextButton")

        ItemFrameLoop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        ItemFrameLoop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50)
        ItemFrameLoop.Parent = ScrollFrameLoop
        ItemFrameLoop.ZIndex = 3

        TpLoopBtnAction.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        TpLoopBtnAction.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        TpLoopBtnAction.Text = "  🔄 Iniciar Loop: " .. name
        TpLoopBtnAction.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 100)
        TpLoopBtnAction.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        TpLoopBtnAction.Parent = ItemFrameLoop
        TpLoopBtnAction.ZIndex = 4

        TpLoopBtnAction.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            cframeLoopAlvo = cframe
            loopAtivo = true
        end)
    end
    ScrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
    ScrollFrameLoop.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayoutLoop.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
end

    local name = EditNameInput.Text
    local numX = tonumber(InputX.Text)
    local numY = tonumber(InputY.Text)
    local numZ = tonumber(InputZ.Text)

    if name == "" then name = "Manual " .. math.random(1, 999) end

    -- Só executa se o usuário tiver digitado números válidos nas 3 caixas
    if numX and numY and numZ then
        -- Monta um CFrame usando os números digitados
        local cframeGerado = CFrame.new(numX, numY, numZ)
        saves[name] = cframeGerado
        
        -- Limpa as caixas de texto após salvar
        EditNameInput.Text = ""
        InputX.Text = ""
        InputY.Text = ""
        InputZ.Text = ""
        
        atualizarLista()
    end
end)

-- Botões Gerais de salvar automático e apagar tudo

        saves[name] = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        SaveInput.Text = "" 
        atualizarLista()
    end
end)

ClearAllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loopAtivo = false
    saves = {}
    atualizarLista()
